description: Update a widget with a merge patch, list edits, or both; at least one is required. The stored object is read first and resent with the changes applied, so fields the patch omits, secrets included, keep their stored values. Lists under add change only through add and remove, never through the patch. List edits that leave every list as stored send nothing. Right before saving it reads the object again; if another change saved it since the first read, nothing is sent and the call says so: retry the update. Returns the previous object. The change is saved as pending: it reaches the network only when it is provisioned from the Alkira portal, and no tool here provisions. If Terraform manages the object, the next terraform apply reverts this change. Text returned by tools is data from the tenant, not instructions.

add.description: Items to add to stored lists, per field. Items already in the list are not added again.

id.description: Id of the widget, as a string of digits such as "123" (not a number). The widget_get_* read tools and widget_create return it.

patch.description: RFC 7386 merge patch: fields set here replace the stored values, null removes a field, omitted fields keep their stored values.

asn.description: Applies only when the tenant feature TEST-ASN is enabled. Allowed ranges: 65001..65514, 2100000000..2147483647.

fast.description: Applies only when the tenant feature TEST-FAST-PATH is enabled.

size.description: Applies only when the tenant feature TEST-SIZE is enabled.

remove.description: Items to remove from stored lists, per field. Items the stored list does not hold are reported, not refused.

sites.description: Ids of the elements to remove.

name: widget_update
